title: Lid flimsy
text: Lid flimsy. Just received my bowl.  I would not wash the lid in the dishwasher as it does not feel like it would hold up.  I own an older 2.5qt that is way studier.  The lid on the new one feels flimsy and does not fit as good. The bowl part seems ok.
